parsed.summary: The PR introduces a change to the migration loader to handle non-namespace packages without __file__ in frozen environments. The change is minimal and aligns with Python's import API.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests to verify the new behavior in frozen environments. It is crucial to ensure that the change works as expected in the intended use case.
